newest.title: OpenAI’s New Healthcare API: Can AI Safely Summarize Your Medical Evidence?
newest.description: OpenAI’s New Healthcare API: Can AI Safely Summarize Your Medical Evidence. OpenAI just launched clinical search tools for developers, but with a 40% failure rate for agents on everyday tasks, how much should we trust them with medical data? Let's talk about the gap between the promise and the performance. What we covered: • OpenAI releases healthcare model configurations in the API for clinical search and evidence synthesis • AP reports U.S. stocks fell after AI shares reversed their rally • Meta and Amazon discuss ending Muse shopping bot blockade Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: Would you trust an AI agent to manage your medical research or shopping list? What to watch next: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
